Expect ~73% one-pass agreement. Tests: zero-miss corpus routines in 12.4 (TIME_$Q_INIT_QUEUE, PROC1_$TST_LOCK, PARITY_$CHK_IO, ...) plus all current conformance/golden green.

title: Diagnostics: show the source line and a caret/underline span in warnings and errors
description: Diagnostic::render (crates/dpc-syntax/src/diag.rs) prints only 'file:line:col: severity: message'; the source text is never shown. Spans already carry file + lo/hi offsets (Span, SourceMap::line_col), so render can print the offending line and mark lo..hi (caret/underline; multi-line spans: first line + marker). Consider: tabs when computing the marker column; spans inside %include files (show the include chain 'in file included from X:N'?); notes/secondary spans if Diagnostic grows them; diagnostics without a position (error_nopos) unchanged. Update the render unit test and any tests/goldens that match on diagnostic output (driver tests in crates/dpc).
